items.exampleEn: Exports of fresh fruit rose by ten percent this year.
items.exampleZh: 今年新鮮水果的出口量增加了百分之十。

items.exampleEn: Products endorsed by famous people often sell better.
items.exampleZh: 由名人代言的產品通常賣得比較好。

items.exampleEn: A cooperative attitude will help you in any job.
items.exampleZh: 樂於合作的態度在任何工作中都對你有幫助。
items.glossZh: 合作的；肯配合的；合作社的

items.exampleEn: She beat her old rival in the final of the chess competition.
items.exampleZh: 她在西洋棋比賽的決賽中擊敗了老對手。

items.exampleEn: Neither side was willing to make a concession.
The movie mogul owns three film studios in Hollywood.
items.exampleZh: 那位電影大亨在好萊塢擁有三座電影製片廠。

items.exampleEn: Selling ice to people in the snow would take great salesmanship.
items.exampleZh: 要把冰賣給住在雪地裡的人，得要有高超的推銷術。

items.sentenceEn: Taiwan exports a lot of computer parts to other countries.
items.sentenceZh: 台灣出口大量的電腦零件到其他國家。

items.audioEn: The famous tennis player agreed to endorse our new running shoes.
items.audioZh: 那位知名網球選手同意替我們的新款跑鞋代言。
items.questionZh: 那位網球選手同意做什麼？
options: Help sell the shoes by promoting them
Buy a pair of the new shoes

items.sentenceEn: The shop offers a concession of ten percent to students.
items.sentenceZh: 那家店給學生打九折的優惠。

items.sentenceEn: The children were very cooperative and cleaned up the room quickly.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們非常配合，很快就把房間整理好了。

items.stemEn: The two coffee chains have been ____ for years, always trying to steal each other's customers.
items.stemZh: 那兩家連鎖咖啡店多年來一直是競爭對手，總想搶走對方的顧客。

items.stemEn: Her ____ is so good that customers often buy more than they planned.
items.stemZh: 她的推銷技巧好到顧客常常買得比原本打算的還多。

items.passageEn: Mr. Kao started selling bicycles from a small shop fifty years ago. Thanks to his salesmanship, the shop grew into a large company, and today he is known as a bicycle mogul. His company now exports bikes to more than thirty countries. For years, its main rival was a company in Japan, but the two firms have recently become more cooperative and even share some parts. To reach young buyers, Mr. Kao asked a popular singer to endorse his electric bikes. When workers asked for more holidays, he made a concession and gave everyone three extra days off. Next year, he plans to begin his retirement.
items.passageZh: 高先生五十年前從一家小店開始賣腳踏車。靠著他的推銷手腕，小店發展成一家大公司，如今他被稱為腳踏車大亨。他的公司現在把腳踏車出口到三十多個國家。多年來，它的主要對手是日本的一家公司，但兩家公司最近變得比較願意合作，甚至共用一些零件。為了吸引年輕買家，高先生請了一位當紅歌手替他的電動腳踏車代言。員工要求更多假期時，他做了讓步，讓每個人多放三天假。明年，他打算退休。

questions.questionZh: 高先生的公司和日本對手最近有什麼改變？
options: 變得比較合作，還共用零件
決定合併成一家更大的國際公司

questions.questionZh: 員工要求更多假期時，高先生怎麼做？

items.promptZh: 茶葉是這個地區最重要的出口品。
referenceEn: Tea is the most important export of this region.
Tea is this region's most important export.
rubricZh: 「出口品」可寫，例如 export、exported product 等
「最重要的」可寫，例如 the most important、the main、the top 等

items.promptZh: 比賽開始前，他和他的對手握了手。
referenceEn: He shook hands with his rival before the match.
Before the game started, he shook his rival's hand.
rubricZh: 「握手」可寫，例如 shook hands with、shook his rival's hand 等；用過去式
「比賽開始前」可寫，例如 before the match、before the game started 等，可放句首或句尾
